name: Public Joint Stock Company Abrau-Durso
summary: Public Joint Stock Company Abrau-Durso produces and sells wine in Russia. The company offers its wine under the Millezims, Alexander II, Brut D'Or Blanc De Blancs, Victor Dravigny, Imperial Domain, Russian Sparkling Wine, Abrau Light, Abrau Wine, and Foliage brand names. It also engages in the culinary school, hotel, spa, restaurant, cafe, event, and confectionery businesses. In addition, the company exports its products. The company was founded in 1870 and is headquartered in Moscow, Russia. Public Joint Stock Company Abrau-Durso is a subsidiary of OOO Aktiv-Media.
